problems: The proposed manual summary attributes the cohort to Figure 2 generally. The Figure 2e caption actually says 530 cells. Its source CSV and the heatmap code establish the 467-cell cohort. Both sequencing analyses used the same six animals.

The search log missed the public study browser linked by both the first author and Correa Lab. I opened the live app. Its three gene inputs drive expression and co-expression plots, and it exposes no mouse-level male-versus-female result table.

The proposed reopening criterion requires literal within-mouse aggregation on the exact Figure 2 cells. The policy also admits a documented compatible cohort and a different estimator if it targets the same animal-level effect. The correction preserves the replication requirement and limits any future comparison to the genes actually reported.
